text:
Hi all! Greg here. Want to thank you for visiting our new PFPI.me website and hope you check back throughout the NFL season for updates.

PFPI is a Cote family tradition -- dare say heirloom? -- that began in the late 1960s, went dormant for a long time, and was revived in 2004. We've been going strong ever since.

This tradition was tantamount to a family secret until it began coming up on our Greg Cote Show podcast and then on the Le Batard Show. Now we are going digital (or whatever the heck this is called) with a website that invites our cherished readers, listeners and YouTube watchers to be a part of our "family secret" for the first time.

Welcome, and enjoy. Our 23rd season of the modern era is about to kick off! 

Greg Cote
PFPI Commissioner
